notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introductory cutscenes have been added for each character, revealing their backstories.
[*] The appearance of the global map screen has been improved.
[*] When equipping units, icons are now displayed on relevant slots if suitable gear or weapons are available.
[*] Geometry and design of several locations have been improved: jump links, textures, enemy spawners, combat zone borders, and various objects have been refined.
[*] The visual appearance of settlements has been updated, and building overlap issues have been fixed.
[*] Texts and descriptions of several quests have been corrected.
[*] The next village defense quest is no longer given immediately after completing the previous one.
[*] Squad commands (Attack, Hold Position, Follow Me) are now preserved when transitioning between stages.

[*] Footstep sounds on different surface types have been fixed.
[*] Some character animations have been improved and corrected.
[*] Fixed: class filters did not work on the weapon trading ship.
[*] Fixed: sudden lighting changes on floor surfaces in certain scenes.
[*] Fixed: the game could crash after reassigning keys.
[*] Spotted text issues have been resolved.
[*] Numerous other minor fixes and improvements have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Your hero can now wield two-handed weapons—spears and axes—whose strikes send enemies flying in all directions.  
[*] The codex has been updated to reflect the rebalancing of weapons and armor, and now includes information about cultists and the new large zombie.  
[*] The reward for defeating Jormund has been increased.  
[*] Added a display of fallen units in the post-battle window.  
[*] The interface now shows the main hero’s level (MC) instead of just the experience bar.  
[*] Barrels in the interface have been sorted in ascending order of their effects.  
[*] Added visual and sound effects for ship sinking.  
[*] Improved the AI of the fallen Torstein.  
[*] Fixed incorrect animations for Emily’s personal set.  
[*] The hero no longer automatically steps forward when attacking a stationary target.  
[*] Fixed: Zombies were shaking while walking.  
[*] Added ally resistance to repeated stuns.  
[*] Fixed: Units were stepping in place.  
[*] Improved wolf textures.  
[*] Fixed: Emilia was receiving Ulvar’s traits.  
[*] Added a "Repair my ship for N coins" option to the shipwright’s dialogue.  
[*] Removed the trade option if the merchant ship is engaged in combat with raiders.  
[*] Improved ship bombardment alerts: added an alarm sound and red numbers flying off the ship’s durability.  
[*] Fixed: The archer was jumping backward.  
[*] Fixed: The team would teleport to the next stage in "hold position" mode and return to the previous stage after the battle.  
[*] Fixed jump links on locations.  
[*] Updated filters on the merchant ship: quest items are now separated from resources and other items.  
[*] Fixed the final battle in the Chromonozhka pack.  
[*] Added a marker for new traits among all unit traits.  
[*] Implemented the ability to remove all items from the bag by holding Y, similar to adding them.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Attention! Due to significant changes in the game, old saves will become unavailable to continue in the new version. If you want to continue the old game, please select the previous version in the settings (Beta versions tab).[/h3]

[h3][list]
[*] The balance of weapons and armor has been completely reworked, about 200 new items with descriptions have been added.
[*] Each item has a tier that limits the use of high-level items when the hero and other characters are not sufficiently pumped.
[*] Fully collected armor sets provide additional bonuses.
[*] The balance of opponents in all locations, the range of merchants and the loot received have been accordingly reworked.
[*] Added 3 types of damage: bleeding, poison and fire.
[*] Added new negative effects for different types of damage, reworked the mechanics of the old ones.
[*] Skald skills in the "Teamwork" branch have been strengthened.
[*] Some locations have been improved in parts of geometry, textures, and content.
[*] New hints and tips on the game have been added to the codex and loading screens.
[*] The interface has been improved: the filter by warrior class is saved during the entire trading session in the weapon and armor shops. Warning has been added when buying an armor or weapon item if it cannot be used by fighters.
[*] Fixed noticed errors in texts and interface elements including the Steam Deck console.
[*] Fixed skeleton animations after losing a shield.
[*] AI settings: Fixed the behavior of the Jol archer. Now he is more careful. Fixed the behavior of the Raider Foreman. Now he does not freeze after hitting with a shield.
[*] Many other small fixes.
[/list][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/1aaede9db89964fff5b31bf21220aad092010b04.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0 (release)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/427c9a17e564d87b7cfbc26e1608dbded4e6c0d4.png[/img]

[h3]Attention! To view new quests and locations you may need to start a new game. Some old saves may not be compatible with the latest version of the game.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Quests have been added to complete the main story in new locations, where the player will meet new opponents and bosses and learn the reasons for the events taking place in the game world. In addition, game mechanics with puzzles, traps and mechanisms are implemented in new locations.
[*] A new roguelike game mode has been added - battles in city taverns. The hero goes out alone with his bare hands against a whole crowd of opponents and tries to hold out as many rounds as possible and earn a reward. After each round the player can choose from a variety of random bonuses. The enemies in the tavern have their own unique appearance and fighting style. Every few rounds the player must defeat one of the tavern champions. Added corresponding achievements.
[*] Added side quests to protect villages from packs of wolves and undead.
[*] The skills of heroes and units have been improved: when upgrading Ulvar along the wolf path, the time he spends in the werewolf state increases; units use their skills only near enemies to cause damage to them. Improved unit AI.
[*] The balance of locations has been adjusted: the levels of some opponents have been changed, their number has been adjusted, mainly towards an increase.
[*] Added character animations in dialogues: shipbuilders Orm and Torm, merchant Boyko.
[*] Some character animations have been improved: Emily's counter strike, Ulvar's rise from the ground, boss death animations. The flight animations of arrows and spears have been made smoother.
[*] Many other improvements have been made to locations related to the interior, appearance and geometry, and camera settings.
[*] Fixed logic and errors in some quests.
[*] The interface has been improved in terms of icons and fonts. The mouse cursor is blocked within the application boundaries. Screen resolutions are limited to 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios.
[*] The travel map has been improved: mooring points at some locations have been corrected; locations are automatically opened when receiving quests for them.
[*] Added sounds for various events, adjusted music volume.
[*] Saving during combat is prohibited.
[*] Noticed errors in texts have been corrected.
[*] Many other small fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.5.0
[/h1]

[list]
[*] New statues of players have been added who help us find bugs and make useful suggestions for the game in their reviews.
[*] Improved hero controls: now running is not interrupted when climbing slopes and stairs; when landing from a low height, the hero does not perform a somersault; the recovery time from a strong attack for Ulvar has been reduced; added the ability to quickly attack directly from sprint.
[*] Special obtained traits have been added for heroes that are different from the rest of the team.
[*] Added resistances and vulnerabilities for various creatures. The bestiary has been implemented as a new section of the ship's log (in addition to the quests section), in which you can see descriptions and characteristics of all creatures. Information is revealed gradually according to the number of battles.
[*] A codex section has also been added there, which contains tips on the game. Hints are additionally displayed on loading screens.
[*] Added another healer to the Freya Forest area and an additional quest for her.
[*] Adjusting the balance of locations: the levels of some enemies have been changed, Trolls have been added to some locations.
[*] A number of locations have been improved in terms of visual representation and geometry: Korgen, Undvik, Ruins of Bjornenburg. In locations with packs of wolves, wolf totems have been added, giving a buff to the squad.
[*] The interface has been improved in terms of icons, shop interface, etc.
[*] Added new animated notifications about leveling up the skills of non-combat professions of team members and about the revealing of new information in the bestiary.
[*] Depending on the method by which the hero died, different messages are displayed.
[*] Dialogue optimization: the question about Tosti can only be asked to each character once.
[*] Several automatic save slots have been implemented for the current game, and the ability to manually save has also been added.
[*] Added some more images for loading screens.
[*] Many other small fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/5d5f2da27ca5242718798587498999fd992a9deb.png[/img]

[h3]🔥 Update 0.4.2[/h3]

[b]🎉 There are never too many New Years! Expect a special event soon to mark the beginning of the Lunar New Year!

Attention! You may need to start a new game to view all changes and improvements.[/b]

⚓ New statues of players have been added who help us find bugs and make useful suggestions for the game in their reviews.
⚓ Added the ability to select professions for team members which allow them to help heal their comrades, cook meals, fish, find more loot, repair the ship faster and much more.
⚓ Added many decorative interior elements for raider cave locations.
⚓ A number of locations have been improved in terms of visual representation and geometry.
⚓ Adjust the balance of weapons, unit strength and location complexity.
⚓ Treating units in the village with a healer now removes not only wounds, but also diseases.
⚓ Improved operation of the interface for keyboard and mouse control.
⚓ Filters are added by type of goods and equipment of the ship in stores.
⚓ Added the ability to view the effects of diseases and traits when selecting warriors for a squad, as well as detailed information about the parameters of equipment that you can take with you.
⚓ The behavior of ships (the player's ship, raiders, merchants) has been corrected so that they do not enter land, freeze or spin in one place.
⚓ The mooring area for some settlements has been increased.
⚓ New notifications have been added to the list of messages: about the theft of money, about the costs of repairing the ship and about the actions of specialist units on board.
⚓ An animated event has been created for a severe ship breakdown.
⚓ Fixed cases of an immortal enemy in boarding battles.
⚓ Fixed: sometimes the pennant for exiting the ruins location did not appear after defeating the boss Pellox.
⚓ Fixed the appearance of debris in places where it is impossible to approach by ship.
⚓ Fixed some errors in the automatic transfer of squad when moving between stages of locations.

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 Traits and Traps
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/3162616025d0289a3eaf52f481ac9297e4ab5b1a.png[/img]

[h2]Balance and gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Team members can now have personality traits that make them more individual. E.g. someone will demand more food every day, and someone will not mind scrounging a little money from the general supply.
[*] Also some warriors may become ill or temporarily injured as a result of battle, which will affect their stats for some time.
[*] Traits and diseases can be viewed in the command window by selecting the appropriate slot. There you can also see statistics on the warrior, how many days he has been on the team, how many battles he has completed, etc.
[*] The ability to knock out weapons from enemies when parrying their attacks has been implemented. In this case they will be forced to engage in hand-to-hand combat.
[*] Improved AI for the Berserker and Viking Defender. The parameters of enemy and allied units have been balanced. Grouth in health has been increased as the level of opponents increases. The health of bosses in non-quest camps and flocks has been increased.
[*] The parameters of some unit and hero skills have been changed for a balanced game.
[*] When landing, starting from the 4th unit in the squad, it is allowed to take +1 to the quantity of each item except alcohol.
[*] If a player raised a wounded unit at a location, then the number of days of treatment for that unit will be large.
[*] The reward for victories in the arena has been increased.
[*] The prices of goods from the gnome Willy have been increased in accordance with inflation.
[*] Fixed: sometimes different health levels of bosses in the large bar below and the small one next to the unit were shown.
[/list]

[h2]Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Traps have been added to locations. Spikes are triggered when friendly and foreign units step on them. Cranes allow you to drop loads on crowds of enemies.
[*] Food tables have been added to many locations, with the help of which the squad can refresh themselves and restore some of their health.
[*] New weapons and armor have been added to unit models. Added variability in character faces.
[*] Improved display and behavior of unit models in locations: incorrect animations, overlapping units, missing armor elements.
[*] New statues of players have been added who help us find bugs and make useful suggestions for the game in their reviews.
[*] Many other improvements have been made to locations related to the location of objects, appearance and geometry.
[*] Fixed: In some locations it was impossible to break slingshots.
[*] Fixed: Altar markers disappeared in the Jormund's Cave location.
[*] Fixed: in some locations the team found itself cut off from the hero at the start of the battle.
[*] Fixed reported errors, stuckness and behavior of units in cut scenes, including boarding battles.
[/list]

[h2]Travel map[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly improved the appearance of all 3 areas of the travel map, including forests, settlements and other objects.
[*] The difficulty of boarding battles has been increased based on the area on the map.
[*] The travel map interface has been improved: animation has been added to the ship's strength icon, and an icon has been added for quick access to the ship's tab.
[*] The health of Snake Jormund in the floating state has been increased.
[*] Fixed the sunken position of some ships.
[*] Fixed multiple raider attacks within one day.
[*] Raiders will now aggress at the player in response to fire.
[*] During naval battles between raiders and merchants, the merchants can sink their opponents.
[*] Fixed: Fishmen ships sometimes could not catch up with the player's ship if they had high speed.
[*] Fixed cases of fog of war reappearing in explored areas.
[/list]

[h2]Quests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the logic of the dialogue with Inga when Tosti returns.
[*] Fixed the behavior of the Snake Jormund when receiving a hunting quest and displaying a mark on the map.
[/list]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added icons for slots when replacing a ship: a green plus sign and a red cross, which indicate new and previously available slots.
[*] In the list of ships for purchase they are sorted by cost with selection by type enabled.
[*] In the description of the ship's equipment, the necessary slot for installation has been added: bow, deck, etc.
[*] Added a hint on blocked slots if they are not available for the current ship.
[*] Fixed: The ship model was not updated when purchasing a new one.
[*] Fixed: Items could be duplicated in ship slots.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Animated notifications have been drawn for events of ship damage and the acquisition of traits and diseases of crew members.
[*] Various errors in displaying tooltips have been corrected, as well as some typos in the texts.
[*] Fixed receiving achievements for defeating Thorstein.
[*] Fixed some cases of game crashes.
[/list]

Dear players! As you know the game is under active development, and your recommendations would greatly help in finalizing the mechanics you like. Would you like to write a small review in which you note the most successful sides of the game and your recommendations for their improvement in your opinion. From our side as a reward for your help we offer to place statues with your nicknames in different locations of the game. The statues will have small but pleasant buffs that can be used in the gameplay.
If you are interested, then proceed as follows:

[olist]
[*] Post a review with your suggestions.
[*] Launch a special statue constructor program and select the type of your statue. Generate the code and write it to us in a personal message from the Steam profile that published the review. 
Send messages 
[list]
[*] to https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198985465836
[*] or https://steamcommunity.com/app/879050/discussions/0/3883850599437263359
[/list]In the letter you can specify the nickname of your statue if it differs from the profile name.

[*] In one of the next updates a statue with your design and nickname will be added which will be mentioned in the description of the update with the place of the statue.
[/olist]

Attention! The developers themselves determine the locations, placements and buffs of the statues. If the nickname or review contains inappropriate or unreliable information, then we may ask you to change it before placing the statue. The offer is valid until there are too many statues for our locations).

[*] Fixed a bug where Verusha did not heal our warriors for free if we defeated Thorstein in battle.

[*] Improved and fixed some hero animations: placing in a block with different sets of weapons.

[*] Improving the player's ship pathfinding so that it doesn't get stuck on the shore.
[*] Improvements on character animations.
[*] Improving the appearance of some locations.
[*] Corrections of spelling and typos in texts.
[/list]
[h2]A small update (in 1-2 weeks)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Several new types of throwing spears and arrows.
[*] Amulets for changing unit characteristics.
[*] Additional loot for sale.
[/list]
[h2]The second small update (in 3-4 weeks)[/h2]
[list]
[*] New enemy classes: fishmen shaman and fishmen heavy infantry.
[*] Fishmen camps with new loot.
[*] Ships of fishmen in the Iron holes area.
[*] Balance adjustment.
[/list]
[h2]Big update (in 1.5-2 months)[/h2]
[list]
[*] An alternative control option for the gamepad.
[*] Processing the AI of NPC ships: raiders, traders, etc.
[*] A side quest with a hunt for a Giant boar.
[*] The plot quest is the hunt for the Sea Serpent Jormund.
[/list]
[h2]The second big update (in 3-4 months)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completion of the quest chain of the ruins explorer at two locations with the boss.
[*] A quest with ingredients to restore the combat capability of units.
[/list]

notes.title: A new character in the game
notes.content:
The giant Ulfbear is a bandit who earns his living by robberies and robbery. He will offer our hero an entertaining task and will generously reward him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/f517c93a0a054e017dcafa41a0ba8ba7c64927a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/2ab3e877347c9e2abdda042ad7b9bcf79ff945ed.png[/img]

notes.title: The change of day and night and not only
notes.content:
Work on the game is still actively ongoing. 
In a recent update of the build, for example, the possibility of reassigning control keys for the keyboard was implemented, also a change of day and night was added to the travel map. And if you lose in a boarding battle, you will lose some of the money now.

When leveling up a player, higher-level units are available for hiring now. Along with the story quests, randomly generated quests for various gangs and camps have been added. Added more animated event notifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/6c0b213f0dd5e0492823832b626f64b8e9d51b06.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Arena Mode in the game
notes.content:
Arena mode has been added to the game!

The Arena master will carefully meet the player, give a couple of parting words, and then leave to the mercy of the 50 best fighters of the region.

But you will definitely cope with them, maybe not the first time... but you can do it!

[previewyoutube=ZkY0wD6cYqM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The hatchets
notes.content:
We often post gameplay battle mechanics here, but sometimes there are such funny hatchets on the levels.
It may seem that it is easy to pass these hatchets, but in fact this obstacle is much more difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/c6ab522d4ec621fa406bb83365d5715ad6c34c34.gif[/img]

notes.title: Murlocs are ready to meet you
notes.content:
Murlocs in their natural habitat are on your screens.

The ground is strewn with food remnants, and eggs are carefully laid in the corners of the cave.
Everything is ready to meet our hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/ae6c1b87fffcf5498b573ee547b76d2a8f322723.png[/img]

notes.title: A new dialog window of completing the game level.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello to everyone![/h1]

Sometimes it happens that some important part of the interface has not been done for a very long time, because it seems that it can be done at any time, simply and quickly.

But it's a trap! We fix this nasty situation! Here is a dialog window of completing the game level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/1ee528f9a6a6651419e0f6cf5421d7ad47332917.gif[/img]

notes.title: The development process...
notes.content:
Meet the totem for summoning zombies.
The second picture shows 4 sketches of what it could be.

Through this totem, one of the bosses in the game will summon his warriors and send their anger, of course, at you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/28e76e6a081e951f0801c9ed06097d8b0998bd26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/fabf9aa8ab2717ca5b0e1b19f769875e835ebd26.png[/img]

notes.title: Fresh dev news!
Greetings to you from our old drakkar!
notes.content:
We work very hard and sail the seas of our game. Smashing to smithereens the sea raiders on your way!

Naval boarding has been added to the game now!

[previewyoutube=tE8m16LadSY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The work is in full swing!
notes.content:
The work is in full swing!

For example Emily is now able to use special attacks in battle. At the arena in the video she has used a "Ramming Attack" and a "Counter Strike".

These attacks are more powerful than usual, and for their use you will only need to wait for a cooldown.

[previewyoutube=btzMnGZQ2FM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 0.1.8027
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/475af67e8dcd3e205cc2ce86ad7b59a80047e560.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Improvements in graphics and geometry of locations: colliders, textures, decor, shadows, rendering order, etc.
[*] Skins have been improved, new ones have been added and some character animations have been fixed: the werewolf Ivar, the dwarf merchant.
[*] Improved AI units especially archers.
[*] Setting up respawn points and waves of enemies.
[*] Added effects for abilities and ults of heroes, strokes of blows for units.
[*] The main menu has been improved: new elements have been added, a flag for Emilia, switching the type of hero when choosing a save slot.
[*] Additions and corrections in dialogs and localization.
[*] Implemented processing of saves incompatible with the current version.
[*] Fixed bugs related to the purchase and use of items and potions.
[*] A lot of other small fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7993
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/344dc6bd589e31c7b0ac25f3c0d2857c34842858.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a new hero class - Skald Emilia to play the demo version. The hero possesses unique skills - battle songs that increase damage and restore the health of the squad. In addition the skald can take 1 more warrior with it.
[*] Changed character control with a gamepad (see tips on buttons in the game) to more efficiently and unambiguously perform different actions.
[*] Improvements in graphics and geometry of locations: colliders, textures, decor, shadows, layers etc.
[*] Squad members can use previously found spears and arrows. Their supply is displayed at the top of the screen along with healing elixirs.
[*] Adjusted the prices in the dwarf's shop and the initial number of player coins.
[*] Improved unit pathfinding.
[*] Fixed errors in texts.
[*] Fixed working with slots for saved games.
[*] Added sounds for some events.
[*] Many other minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7970
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/bda165f1f3a7feca25acac4ae427d3255d5410b8.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Improvements in graphics and geometry of locations: textures, decor, shadows, etc.
[*] Found elixirs that can be used in battle are displayed in the interface.
[*] Setting the location, size and appearance of interface elements.
[*] Added display of icons for found loot.
[*] Fixed bugs in animations of the death of characters.
[*] The hero takes minor damage when falling from a height.
[*] Setting sounds at locations in accordance with the type of surface. Added sounds for breaking structures and opening gates.
[*] Fixed errors in texts.
[*] Fixed errors when using load / save the game.
[*] Many other minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7950
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371326/ed3517ca5cdc1fd66dd10eb6d9961737796d77a9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added 2nd set of weapons to the character: shield and sword. Switch beetween weapons set using the D-pad Up (TAB). Previously switching also worked but the hero dressed up without any weapon.
[*] Reduced increasing of character parameters when leveling up for balancing purposes.
[*] Wild hunters are divided into 2 classes: skirmishers (throw spears) and shield guards. Both classes have improved intelligence behavior made more aggressive.
[*] Improvements in graphics and geometry of locations: textures, decor, shadows, etc.
[*] Added a chance to drop healing potions, arrows and javelins from barrels and chests.
[*] Changes in the main interface, indicators (bars) of characters and displaying of NPC phrases.
[*] Added more tips for control keys.
[*] Fixed misplaced sounds for some characters.
[*] Fixed: the character did not restore his stock when finding spears. After the dialogue was closed the animation of the character's conversation did not stop.
[*] Many other minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]
